items.label: Portable processing unit - structural base
items.detail: Concept enclosure: 154 x 110 mm footprint, nominal. 3D-printed housing is NOT verified to fit a final USB interface or battery.

items.label: Detachable service cover
items.detail: Removable top cover. Select OPEN to reveal Pi PCB and shared-clock dual-input ADC. Screw locations and cutouts are illustrative.

items.label: Rear strap attachment
items.detail: Attach with a tested mounting method; this render does not certify impact retention.

items.label: Rear strap attachment
items.detail: Attach with a tested mounting method; this render does not certify impact retention.

items.label: Microphone channel 1 input connector
items.detail: Primary mic enters analog input 1 on the SAME two-channel ADC clock. Connector type provisional.

items.label: Microphone channel 2 input connector
items.detail: Ambient reference enters analog input 2 on the same ADC. Distinct clock-domain USB microphones are not assumed to be synchronized.

items.label: 5 V power via USB-C
items.detail: Pi 4 requires a suitable 5 V / 3 A rated USB-C power source. Battery pack is EXTERNAL until a real protected supply is chosen.

items.label: Onboard Wi-Fi / network stack
items.detail: Lab proof: Pi 4 onboard Wi-Fi sends framed enhanced audio over a known local WLAN. For a remote field scenario, separate approved infrastructure is needed.

items.label: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B
items.detail: Real Pi 4 class SBC; nominal PCB about 85 x 56 mm. The processor runs dual-channel capture and, after the native port, hybrid NLMS plus a real licensed RNNoise model. Current app is offline, not verified hardware.

items.label: Two-channel synchronized USB audio ADC - placeholder PCB
items.detail: Interface footprint is RESERVED ONLY, not a validated or selected product. Buy and test an actual Linux UAC-compatible 2-mic-channel ADC; dimensions and connectors will change.

items.label: USB cable - shared ADC to Raspberry Pi
items.detail: Two channels travel together over the selected capture device and one host USB interface.

items.label: External regulated 5 V power bank - unselected
items.detail: Conceptual regulated 5 V / 3 A capable supply; the actual battery and regulation must be validated under Pi load. Not a custom unprotected Li-ion pack.

items.label: USB power cable from external bank to field enclosure
Enclosed headphone earcup
items.detail: Earcups are enclosure visualization only. No hearing protection or ballistic rating is claimed.

items.label: Enclosed headphone earcup
items.detail: Earcups are enclosure visualization only. No hearing protection or ballistic rating is claimed.

items.label: CH1 - near-mouth speech microphone
items.detail: Close-talk microphone; captures voice PLUS background noise. It is not assumed to be perfectly clean. Connects into ADC channel 1.

items.label: CH2 - ambient reference microphone
items.detail: Separate ambient-noise sensor. Placement, speech leakage and mic-to-mic acoustic correlation must be measured.

items.label: Push-to-talk control, pending audio transport implementation
items.detail: Physical push-to-talk control concept, not yet connected electrically or integrated into native streaming code. A demonstrator can later wire an isolated tactile switch to verified GPIO input.

items.label: SBC SOC heat spreader visualization
items.detail: Provisional heat spreading shown; real heat sink fit/cooling and thermal testing required.

items.label: Control-room workstation - notebook/desktop terminal
items.detail: Receiving terminal can be a laptop or Raspberry Pi, provided it can decode, buffer and play an authorized IP audio stream.

items.label: Secure/approved link receiving client - illustrative screen
items.detail: Control-side receiving application buffers and plays enhanced audio. Live connection quality would only appear after a real tested communication link.

items.label: Lab Wi-Fi access point (short-range prototype only)
items.detail: Wi-Fi lab demo requires real tested network coverage and IP transport. This does NOT represent battlefield-range radio or secure connectivity.
